visualCharacteristics: Full-width featured-experience band with an art-directed image (separate desktop and mobile crops), a large headline, a short lede and a single primary CTA.
contentPattern: Row 1: desktop image (>= 1200px). Row 2: optional mobile image (< 1200px); a single image row is used at all widths. Row 3: h2 headline, lede paragraph, CTA paragraph (bold link = primary button).
usage: Featured campaign or promotion band near the top of a homepage or landing page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single campaign banner with image, headline, lede and one CTA. Use carousel or teaser-block for multiple promos.
